summary: Oversized leaf - fails the one-behavior limit. Three independently testable behaviors are bundled: (1) per-predator signature rules, 4-6 distinct controllers each up to ~120 lines (section 19), each independently shippable and testable via its own trigger-plus-control scenario; (2) the section 10 damage model per size class, a shared mechanic independently verifiable without any specific predator controller (harpoon cost, deter success, no-kill for large); (3) the FINAL PROOF headless roster check, a cross-tier integration test with a different dependency profile (requires WI-03b friendly species to be landed). The non-chase hunting strategy is a specific instance of behavior (1) and does not add a count. The 3 named subsystems are at the cap, but the behavior count exceeds 1. Recommended split: WI-03c1a - tier-3 CreatureDefs plus section 10 damage model per size class (foundation: world content data, creature simulation; criterion AC-roster-behavior); WI-03c1b (depends on WI-03c1a) - per-predator controllers including the non-chase strategy, per-predator headless signature scenarios, and the final roster-wide AC-roster-behavior proof (creature simulation, headless scenario tests; criteria AC-roster-behavior, AC-roster-tests). Each child has a strict subset of the parent's 3 subsystems. Scope is preserved: the tier still lands with definitions, controllers, the non-chase strategy, the damage model, per-predator tests, and the cross-tier proof; only ownership is divided into two sequentially dependent leaves.
